title: South Downs Way 100 — World Trail Majors all-races listing
claims: The World Trail Majors all-races listing describes the South Downs Way 100 as a 100-mile (160-kilometre) point-to-point race following the historic South Downs Way national trail through rolling terrain, past ancient Roman forts and through villages in southern England.
The same listing gives the South Downs Way 100 dates as 2026/06/13-14 and places the entry in the World Trail Majors all-races grid.
